Notes_and_Tips: For endometriosis: include anti-inflammatory foods like turmeric, leafy greens, and omega sources.
Prefer whole grains and millets; avoid processed and deep-fried foods.
When craving spicy foods, use fresh spices and avoid oily preparations.
Keep meals regular and avoid long fasting which can trigger overeating.
Include gentle exercise like yoga to manage pain and stress.
Stay hydrated and prioritize sleep when possible.
